Title: Relates to notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases
Summary: Requires notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases to include a statement on the first page explaining in plain language the tenant's right to answer or reply and how a tenant may request an extension of time to submit such answer or reply.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to notice of applications for major capital improvement rent increases
